title: egress-audit.config.json
description: A product's egress audit configuration. Paths are relative to this file. No name of the never-allowed list (ever-hosts.json: the Ever-owned names, the analytics sinks and every name under them) can be allowed: this schema refuses them in allowed_external_hosts, and the capture checks fail on them whatever the configuration says.

compose.description: The product's compose files, in order.

project.description: The compose project name prefix (default ever-audit-<product>).

api_service.description: The service that answers health_url and the module routes.

process_services.description: Every service that runs product code (API, workers, schedulers): each gets its own sniffer.

services.description: The services to start (with their dependencies); default: every service of the compose files.

build.description: Build the product images before the run (docker compose up --build).

health_url.description: Reached from inside the audit network, by service name.

module_routes.description: Routes of the Ever Platform modules (at least one); in the off mode every one must answer 404.

allowed_external_hosts.description: Names outside the compose services the product and the browser may look up (they still reach nothing). A name of the never-allowed list is refused: the pattern below is generated from ever-hosts.json, and a test keeps the two equal.

web_service.description: The compose service that serves the product UI. Naming it turns the browser leg on (--legs api,browser becomes the default).

web_url.description: The UI's address from inside the sealed network, by service name (for example http://webapp:4200).

ui_routes.description: The route list the browser walks (default ui-routes.json; see ui-routes.schema.json and ever-egress-audit ui-routes).

route_params.description: Static route parameter values, {name: value} or {"/path/:name": {name: value}} (default route-params.json when present); the adapter's routeParams hook adds the values only a run knows.

ui_baseline.description: DOM references that pre-date the modules, {route, attribute, url, reason} (default ui-baseline.json when present; see ui-baseline.schema.json). It may only shrink, and it never excuses a DNS query, a connection attempt or a HAR entry.

idle_pages.description: Routes of the route list held open for idle_s after they load (settings, integrations, catalog).

idle_s.description: Seconds each idle page is held open (default 30).

ui_page_timeout_s.description: Seconds a page may take to load before its one retry (default 60).

ui_skip_routes.description: Routes of the route list the browser does not open, each with its reason. A route with a parameter that has no value must be listed here, or the run faults.

ui_expected_requests.description: The browser leg's positive control, per mode: the requests ("METHOD /path") the browser must make to a compose service, for example {"positive_stats": ["GET /api/ever-stats/status"]}. Required for a mode whose browser leg is positive.

optin_hosts.description: The product's documented operator opt-ins (default optin-hosts.json; see optin-hosts.schema.json). Only static-hostnames reads it; the capture checks never do.

browser_image.description: The browser image (default: the harness's pinned Playwright image); it must carry the browser build of the bundled playwright-core.

wait_s.description: Seconds to watch the product after the scenario (default 120).

env_prefix.description: Replaces the leading EVER_ of every mode variable (for example TR_EVER_).

phase.description: The highest phase whose outbound-call rows apply (default 2).

mock_image.description: A published mock platform image; default: built from the bundled mock.

mock_config.description: Merged into the mock platform configuration of positive modes.

modes.description: Extra product modes (for example connect off and sign-in on), in the shape of modes.json.
